title: Depletion of Loss-of-function Germline Mutations in Centenarians Reveals Longevity Genes

fields.title: Depletion of Loss-of-function Germline Mutations in Centenarians Reveals Longevity Genes
fields.authors: K Ying, JP Castro, AV Shindyapina, A Tyshkovskiy, M Moqri, LJE Goeminne, …, VN Gladyshev
fields.description: Analysis of centenarian genomes reveals depleted loss-of-function mutations in specific genes, identifying genetic variants that contribute to exceptional longevity.

descriptions.text: Analysis of centenarian genomes reveals depleted loss-of-function mutations in specific genes, identifying genetic variants that contribute to exceptional longevity.

Whole-exome sequencing of Ashkenazi Jewish cohorts showed that centenarians carry an 11 to 22% lower burden of rare loss-of-function mutations than controls, and their offspring show a similar pattern. Gene-level tests with Mendelian randomization and multi-omic data identified RGP1, PCNX2 and ANO9 as longevity genes.
